query:
INSERT INTO curatedThoughts (
  userId,
  title,
  content,
  originalContent,
  category,
  sentiment,
  sourcePrivateThoughtId,
  commercializationStatus,
  isApprovedByOwner,
  tags,
  createdAt,
  curatedAt
)
SELECT
  pt.userId,
  CONCAT(SUBSTRING(pt.content, 1, 80), '...') as title,
  pt.content,
  SUBSTRING(pt.content, 1, 500) as originalContent,
  COALESCE(pt.thoughtType, 'thought') as category,
  COALESCE(pt.emotionalTone, 'neutral') as sentiment,
  pt.id,
  'private' as commercializationStatus,
  false as isApprovedByOwner,
  JSON_ARRAY(COALESCE(pt.thoughtType, 'thought')) as tags,
  pt.createdAt,
  NOW() as curatedAt
FROM privateThoughts pt
WHERE pt.userId = 1
  AND pt.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT sourcePrivateThoughtId FROM curatedThoughts WHERE sourcePrivateThoughtId IS NOT NULL)
LIMIT 200;
